main.description: Public profile revision. Repository DID is the immutable serial; the separately resolved handle is not stored here. Call sign, emoji, icon and theme may change.

record.description: Latest profile revision selected by application policy. No field changes repository DID.

callSign.description: Human display call sign, not an address or verified handle.

genesisCid.description: CIDv1 0x71 SHA-256 of the DID-independent genesis certificate, not the profile or its resulting DID.
